definitions.explanation: Having mental or spiritual strength; being able to overcome difficulties.

⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たくましく⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My son has grown up strong.

examples.english: He lifted the luggage effortlessly with his sturdy arms.

examples.english: Because I train every day, my body has become more muscular.

examples.english: With a resilient spirit, I overcame the difficulties.

examples.english: The greatest wish of parents is for their children to grow up strong and resilient.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: たくましく (sturdily, strongly)
- Noun form: たくましさ (sturdiness, robustness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たくましい⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧/⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (sturdy body/arms)
- たくましく⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧/⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to grow up strong)
- たくましい⟦{精神力|せいしんりょく}→精神力：17976_seishinryoku⟧ (strong willpower)

KANJI FORM:
{逞|たくま}しい exists but hiragana is standard.

USAGE:
Positive connotation. For physical strength, implies healthy, muscular build rather than just size. For mental strength, implies resilience and the ability to thrive despite challenges.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たくましい: emphasizes robust strength and vitality
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: general strength
- ⟦{頑丈|がんじょう}→頑丈：08639_ganjou⟧: durability, solidness
